method: Direct manual comparison of parent native view and returned native image, with after 720/320 reductions; no crops, compositing, image alterations or pixel-preservation claim.

changed_text_observations.evidence: Title remains large and heavy in the same upper position. Subtitle has less heavy strokes and occupies a slightly shorter horizontal span than parent.
changed_text_observations.implication: Some distinction between title and subtitle is visible, though subtitle remains large.

changed_text_observations.evidence: Date remains large and bold; time and place are visibly lighter and occupy shorter spans. Audience moves directly below place, reducing the previous separating gap.
changed_text_observations.implication: Date/time/place/audience now form one event/eligibility group. The requested moderate date scale was only partially followed: date is still a strong headline-like element.

changed_text_observations.evidence: Bring-item sentence is heavier than the exclusion row, with a larger gap above the pair. Tight 전기·배터리 separator visually restored.
changed_text_observations.implication: The pair has a clearer role through weight contrast and spacing.

changed_text_observations.evidence: Two regular-weight full-width lines appear after a larger gap from exclusion; both remain readable at 720.
changed_text_observations.implication: Operational support/limit clauses are grouped rather than an uninterrupted uniform list.

changed_text_observations.evidence: Consent regular row followed by visibly bold fee; red deadline/URL remains prominent at bottom with normal-looking upright letter proportions and no clipping.
changed_text_observations.implication: Fee and action have distinct emphasis; all exact text is retained.

outside_changed_type_observations.before: Lens at left, hinge near center, open temple down/right, diagonal driver from upper/right, photo ending at same horizontal boundary.
outside_changed_type_observations.after: The same overall composition, crop, object positions and focus ordering remain visible.
outside_changed_type_observations.retention_assessment: Broad geometry appears retained; no lossless geometry claim.

outside_changed_type_observations.region: Foreground gray surface and surface seen through lens
outside_changed_type_observations.before: Fine granular/mottled detail, comparatively softly distributed at native scale.
outside_changed_type_observations.after: Visible small curved/scribbly patterns are more pronounced, particularly in foreground below lens and through its lower portion.
outside_changed_type_observations.retention_assessment: Unrequested surface-detail change is visible; possible material regression. Photo was not preserved exactly despite local typography request.

outside_changed_type_observations.before: Bright curved lens rim with smooth dark acetate highlights and amber translucent edge points.
outside_changed_type_observations.after: Same broad reflections, rim and dark acetate form remain, but local edge highlight/texture appears slightly rebuilt.
outside_changed_type_observations.retention_assessment: Material character mostly recognizable; exact local edge/reflection preservation uncertain.

outside_changed_type_observations.before: Bright chunky hinge, top-facing screw-like head, obliquely approaching tip.
outside_changed_type_observations.after: Same broad hinge/head/shaft relationship remains. Slightly different localized metal marks/highlight shapes are visible.
outside_changed_type_observations.retention_assessment: No obvious gross loss of the contact scene, but fine metal details are not guaranteed unchanged. Existing mechanical seating uncertainty remains.

outside_changed_type_observations.before: Soft cool light, sharper repair point and softer surrounding lens/table/temple.
outside_changed_type_observations.after: Soft cool illumination and focal repair point remain similar; no new gross shadow-direction mismatch identified.
outside_changed_type_observations.retention_assessment: Broad light/focus character appears retained; small texture contrast changes are recorded separately.

candidate_selection_note: The repair stage final.png preserves the returned native candidate. This is not a declaration that the repair is the selected overall final or better than the preserved parent; coordinator must weigh typography changes against photo regression.
